name: Level One Mounts
description: Ride at level 1 (pure SQL despite the 'mod-' repo name).

sql.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yulon_lvl1_mounts_item_backup (entry INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, RequiredLevel INT NOT NULL, BuyPrice BIGINT NOT NULL, SellPrice BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;
sql.note: the undo, taken before anything is changed: the 40 mounts' level and prices

sql.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yulon_lvl1_mounts_trainer_backup (ID INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, SpellID INT NOT NULL, ReqLevel INT NOT NULL, MoneyCost INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (ID, SpellID)) ENGINE=InnoDB;
sql.note: and Apprentice Riding's level and cost at every trainer

sql.statement: INSERT IGNORE INTO yulon_lvl1_mounts_item_backup (entry, RequiredLevel, BuyPrice, SellPrice) SELECT entry, RequiredLevel, BuyPrice, SellPrice FROM item_template WHERE entry IN (1132,2411,2414,5655,5656,5665,5668,5864,5872,5873,8563,8588,8591,8592,8595,8629,8631,8632,13321,13322,13331,13332,13333,15277,15290,28481,28927,29220,29221,29222,29743,29744,33224,33976,43599,46099,46100,46308,47100,49283) AND NOT (RequiredLevel = 1 AND BuyPrice = 10 AND SellPrice = 4);
sql.note: INSERT IGNORE so a second install never overwrites the ORIGINAL values; a row already at the level-one values (an install from before the backup existed) is never recorded as an original. The ids are level-one-mounts.sql's own list

sql.statement: INSERT IGNORE INTO yulon_lvl1_mounts_trainer_backup (ID, SpellID, ReqLevel, MoneyCost) SELECT ID, SpellID, ReqLevel, MoneyCost FROM npc_trainer WHERE ReqSkillLine = 762 AND ReqSkillRank = 0 AND NOT (ReqLevel = 1 AND MoneyCost = 4);
sql.note: the same for the trainer rows level-one-mounts.sql changes (ReqSkillLine 762, rank 0)
upstream's level-one file; the backup above is taken first so Remove can put every value back exactly

sql.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yulon_lvl1_mounts_item_backup (entry INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, RequiredLevel INT NOT NULL, BuyPrice BIGINT NOT NULL, SellPrice BIGINT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;
sql.note: so removing an install from before the backup existed still has a table to read (it holds nothing)

sql.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yulon_lvl1_mounts_trainer_backup (ID INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, SpellID INT NOT NULL, ReqLevel INT NOT NULL, MoneyCost INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (ID, SpellID)) ENGINE=InnoDB;

sql.note: upstream's revert sets level 20 and ten times AzerothCore's stock prices (10 gold mounts, 10 gold riding). T763: together with the backups put back after it, which hold every row level-one-mounts.sql changes, it takes that file back in full. An install from before the backups is put back to stock by the steps after the restore.

sql.statement: UPDATE item_template t JOIN yulon_lvl1_mounts_item_backup b ON b.entry = t.entry SET t.RequiredLevel = b.RequiredLevel, t.BuyPrice = b.BuyPrice, t.SellPrice = b.SellPrice;
UPDATE npc_trainer t JOIN yulon_lvl1_mounts_trainer_backup b ON b.ID = t.ID AND b.SpellID = t.SpellID SET t.ReqLevel = b.ReqLevel, t.MoneyCost = b.MoneyCost;

sql.note: T763 review round 2: an install from before the backups has none, so its rows are still at exactly the level-twenty values after the revert; those go to the pinned core's stock (azerothcore-wotlk @2a2211cd base item_template: RequiredLevel 20, these prices). Rows with a backup row were put back above and are not touched

sql.statement: UPDATE item_template t LEFT JOIN yulon_lvl1_mounts_item_backup b ON b.entry = t.entry SET t.BuyPrice = 10000, t.SellPrice = 0 WHERE b.entry IS NULL AND t.entry IN (33224,49283) AND t.RequiredLevel = 20 AND t.BuyPrice = 100000 AND t.SellPrice = 25000;

UPDATE item_template t LEFT JOIN yulon_lvl1_mounts_item_backup b ON b.entry = t.entry SET t.BuyPrice = 100000, t.SellPrice = 0 WHERE b.entry IS NULL AND t.entry IN (33976) AND t.RequiredLevel = 20 AND t.BuyPrice = 100000 AND t.SellPrice = 25000;

UPDATE item_template t LEFT JOIN yulon_lvl1_mounts_item_backup b ON b.entry = t.entry SET t.BuyPrice = 0, t.SellPrice = 0 WHERE b.entry IS NULL AND t.entry IN (43599) AND t.RequiredLevel = 20 AND t.BuyPrice = 100000 AND t.SellPrice = 25000;

UPDATE npc_trainer t LEFT JOIN yulon_lvl1_mounts_trainer_backup b ON b.ID = t.ID AND b.SpellID = t.SpellID SET t.MoneyCost = 40000 WHERE b.ID IS NULL AND t.ReqSkillLine = 762 AND t.ReqSkillRank = 0 AND t.ReqLevel = 20 AND t.MoneyCost = 100000;
sql.note: the same for Apprentice Riding: stock is 40000 at level 20 (npc_trainer 202010, spell 33388, the only ReqSkillLine 762 rank 0 row at the pin)

notes: Upstream's revert (level-twenty-mounts.sql) sets fixed level-twenty values, at ten times AzerothCore's stock prices, so the tables `yulon_lvl1_mounts_item_backup` and `yulon_lvl1_mounts_trainer_backup` are filled before the level-one file and put back after the revert on Remove. Do not drop them by hand. An install from before the backups has none: Remove puts rows still at the level-twenty values back to AzerothCore's stock.
